name: Chris Evans
education: B.S. in Software Engineering, San Diego State University
summary: Junior backend engineer with 3 years of experience building Go and Python services. Early-career architect with solid fundamentals in system design and APIs, but no production experience designing distributed systems, sharded databases, or large-scale scalability.
strengths: Solid Go fundamentals building backend services and REST APIs
Good system design instincts for small-to-medium services
Fast learner eager to work on distributed systems
gaps: Limited PostgreSQL depth beyond basic queries
No hands-on scalability or high-concurrency design work
resumeText: Chris Evans is a Backend Engineer at Static Field Labs with three years of experience, the first two at Kiteworks Digital. He writes Go and Python services and has solid system design fundamentals, but he is early in his career: he has not yet designed production distributed systems, worked with PostgreSQL at scale, or owned scalability decisions.
